description: Election Commission - S. Raththinasingam was elected as the member of the Thunukkai Pradeshiya Sabha - A. A. S. P. Jayasiri was elected as the member of Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically deals with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to members not attending meetings or death, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies through a process managed by election officials. This falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
